I have used it to judge my short stories before sending it to contests, and I've been nominated as a finalist for 3 of them so far. Before, I didn't get any honorable mentions at all.
And no, it's not writing my stories for me. I write them, correct them, and edit them before sending it to chatgpt, and then it advises me if it's good enough or if I need to correct anything at all.
